_note: The external LLM providers this platform can reach, in ONE table. Every place
that names a provider reads it from here: the credential loaders, the
key-present check behind the fallback chain, the settings page's key handling,
the catalogue script. Until 2026-09-12 that list stood in nine places, and
three of them sent 'anthropic/' to three different places.
A provider is the first segment of a platform model id ('mammouth/glm-5.3',
'openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-5'). What follows the first slash is the
model path AS THE PROVIDER PUBLISHES IT, verbatim.
dialect: 'chat_completions' = OpenAI-style /v1/chat/completions with a Bearer
key; 'messages' = Anthropic's /v1/messages with an x-api-key header; 'bedrock'
= the AWS SDK, which keeps its own credentials and has no key file.
key_prefix: what a line in the key file has to start with to count as the
key; empty where the provider's keys have no fixed shape. Key files sit in
devserver/ and are ignored by git.
image_input (optional): false where the connection takes no picture. That is
a floor under the measurements in services/model_capabilities, a property of
the connection and not of a model behind it; the reader builds the request
without the image. Absent means the question is open and a measurement decides.
thinking_off_payload (optional): request fields the pipeline engine adds when a
config switched thinking off, for a provider whose reasoning models cannot be
told to stop reasoning but can be told to keep it short.
account_api, credits_url and key_url: which account API the provider
answers, and where. The readers are in services/provider_account.py, one
per API: 'litellm' is a LiteLLM proxy's account route (/user/info) at
credits_url; 'openrouter' is OpenRouter's key route (/key, what the key
has spent) at key_url and its credits route at credits_url, which
OpenRouter's API reference (read 2026-09-26) answers to a management key
only and shows on openrouter.ai, not on the eu host these addresses use; on
2026-09-26 it answered the key held here on the eu host, which the key
route marks is_management_key false. A
provider without account_api has no account reading, and its pages say
that the provider reports none. By the documentation read 2026-09-26,
Anthropic, OpenAI and Mistral AI report a key's spend or the account's
spend, where at all, only to an admin key and document no route for the
credit balance (platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/usage-cost-api,
developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/admin-apis,
docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/beta/admin/billing); IONOS reports metered
quantities of a contract, without money or balance, to its owners and
admins, and a Model Hub token belongs to a user the docs advise to hold
only the Model Hub right
(docs.ionos.com/cloud/api-reference/observability/billing-api/access-permissions,
docs.ionos.com/cloud/ai/ai-model-hub/how-tos/access-management).
Mammouth's
credits_url is the account's (/user/info): the key held here carried no
budget of its own (/key/info named max_budget null for it on 2026-09-23),
so /key/info, read until that day, gave no balance.
OpenRouter is reached on its EU host, eu.openrouter.ai: the key's workspace
is bound to that hostname ('the key's workspace permits requests only on
these OpenRouter hostnames: eu.openrouter.ai', 2026-09-10), and the global
host refuses such a key. The ComfyUI LLM nodes in comfyui_nodes/ai4artsed_comfyui/
call the DevServer (POST /api/chat/proxy), and the package's key node reads
this table by path, so the host and the key stand in one place.
What the platform RECORDS about a provider's data path is not here. That is
the operator's entry under llm_presets in hardware_matrix.json, keyed by the
same name.

mistral.label: Mistral AI
mistral._note_regional: Mistral is reached on its EU host, api.eu.mistral.ai (Regional Inference): the global host api.mistral.ai commits to no inference location, and the regional guarantee is what the DSGVO preset rests on. The +10% regional surcharge applies; the control is the endpoint, not a console toggle (docs.mistral.ai/inference/regional-inference, read 2026-09-27). The EU host serves the stateless chat endpoint only: Agents, Batch and Files API are not available there, and the pipeline calls none of them.
